columns.label: G
columns.help: Games played within the selected filters.

columns.label: Dropbacks
columns.help: Dropbacks: pass attempts plus sacks taken.

columns.label: EPA/Play
columns.help: EPA per dropback, sacks included. Expected points added: how much a play changed the offense's expected points, based on down, distance and field position before and after it.

columns.label: Success
columns.help: Success rate on dropbacks. Share of plays that kept the offense on schedule: at least 50% of the yards to go on 1st down, 70% on 2nd, and all of it on 3rd or 4th. Touchdowns always count; turnovers never do.

columns.label: Air Yards/Att
columns.help: Average distance past the line of scrimmage the ball traveled on each attempt. Needs full play descriptions, so 2022-2024 are blank.
